title.why: Rendering of the strategy's own name 'AI for Humanity' with an accurate English descriptor; english_version none found is correct.

original_title.why: The press kit gives 'LA STRATÉGIE AI FOR HUMANITY' and 'la stratégie AI for Humanity'; no single strategy document exists. Case differs from the capitals of the heading.

summary_claims.claim: EUR 1.5 billion over the five-year term; Inria-coordinated national programme
summary_claims.locator: press kit page 5 (1,5 milliard ... quinquennat; programme national coordonné par Inria)

summary_claims.claim: speech: public transparency of algorithms, European reflection on control and certification of algorithms, an IPCC-like body (GIEC de l'IA)
summary_claims.locator: Elysee speech, algorithm and GIEC passages; literal: 'mettre partout de la transparence publique sur les algorithmes' / 'réflexion européenne et internationale sur le contrôle et la certification des algorithmes'

summary_claims.claim: EUR 100 million seed, 70 million a year via Bpifrance, 400 million for innovation challenges, 500 million private investment; algorithm code public by default, Parcoursup

scope.note: No single strategy document; speech and press kit; strategy with ethics pillar. Extractor's scope_note kept.

note: Strategy, date and funding are confirmed by the ministry press kit (official) and the Elysee speech (host not yet official for FR; quotes count as secondary). A search found a second phase launched in November 2021 that official-style sources describe as a continuation, not a replacement, so the status stays; a later run may add it as a separate record.
